task: Enable advisory cited REV denial diagnostics in SDK CI without changing approval or application behavior.

criteria.description: The complete-PR evaluator and unprivileged tool checkout use immutable REV commit 8a8a3889e57dd8e7498af201ade6e34a4c731bfe. The evaluator enables diagnose-denials. On model denial, the advisory pass identifies an exact obligation span, a supplied-source line range, a gap category and a next check, or explicitly reports uncertainty when a grounded finding is unavailable. References are validated locally; source line ranges are not repository lines and findings are not proven defects. Diagnostic errors cannot change the original decision, approval, reason or exit status. Existing probability/confidence thresholds and all CI dependencies remain unchanged. The unprivileged job runs diagnostic regression tests, including action integration, rejection of invented citations, low confidence and provider failures.

SDK retains all existing CI checks as required REV dependencies. It recognizes both the standard TYPESAFE_API_KEY and the existing TUPESAFE_API_KEY secret names, without printing secret values. Collection and evaluator jobs do not install or execute application code with the API key.

The PR task, original request, file mappings and source manifest describe this diagnostic rollout and include the pinned diagnostic implementation and tests. Operator documentation explains opt-in diagnostics, supplied-evidence line references, uncertainty, and unchanged approval. The committed diff changes only CI/REV configuration and tests; the existing empty changeset declares no package release. Application code and public APIs remain unchanged.
